title: Nub: a single Rust binary that replaces nodemon, nvm, and your TS build step
description:
The day-to-day Node-dot-JS toolchain forces you to manage a bloated pile of utilities like nodemon or nvm. Nub replaces that entire stack with a single Rust binary that runs on top of your existing Node installation. It lets you execute TypeScript directly without any build steps. It also features a faster script runner and auto-provisions Node versions on demand with no runtime lock-in. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/nubjs/nub
